Title: Install Unity 6000.5.6f1 (the GC26 project's version) with Android Build Support (OpenJDK, Android SDK & NDK Tools)
Done When: Unity 6000.5.6f1 with the Android module appears under Installs in Unity Hub

Title: Install Visual Studio 2022 (Unity workload) or VS Code + Unity extension and set it as the external script editor
Done When: Double-clicking a script opens it with autocomplete working

Title: Prepare the GC26 project on branch gc26_minesweeper: switch platform to Android, set Portrait, make the camera orthographic, add the 2D Sprite package, create the folders
Done When: Platform shows Android, orientation is Portrait, camera is orthographic; Scripts/Core, View, UI, Managers plus Sprites, Prefabs, Scenes, Audio folders exist

Title: Check Git for the gc26_minesweeper branch: .gitignore excludes Library/Temp/Logs, commit the setup and push
Done When: The setup commit is on GitHub in gc26_minesweeper and the Library folder is not in it

Title: Enable Developer options and USB debugging on the phone; Build And Run an empty scene
Done When: The empty app opens on the phone

Title: C# refresher: classes, 2D arrays, List, Queue, enums, Random, MonoBehaviour basics
Done When: You can explain Start, Update and [SerializeField]

Title: Write the Cell class
Done When: The class has IsMine, AdjacentMines, IsRevealed, IsFlagged

Title: Write the Board class: constructor, Cell grid, GetCell, InBounds, Neighbours
Done When: A board of any size can be created; corners return 3 neighbours

Title: Implement PlaceMines(safeX, safeY) with the 3x3 safe area
Done When: The exact number of red flags (mines in code) is placed and none lands in the safe area

Title: Implement CalculateNumbers()
Done When: Every safe cell stores its correct neighbour mine count

Title: Write a temporary BoardDebug script that prints the board to the Console
Done When: Play mode prints a readable grid that you check by hand

Title: Find or draw sprites (at least 128x128 px): hidden, empty, 1-8, yellow flag (player marker), rectangular red flag (hazard), hit red flag, crossed-out yellow flag
Done When: All 14 sprites are in Assets/Sprites; red and yellow flags are easy to tell apart on a phone

Title: Set the sprite import settings (PPU = sprite size, Compression None/High Quality, mipmaps off)
Done When: Sprites look sharp on a high-resolution screen and each one is 1 world unit wide

Title: Create the Tile prefab (SpriteRenderer + BoxCollider2D) and the TileView script
Done When: The prefab exists with all sprites assigned in the Inspector

Title: Write BoardView.Build() to spawn one tile per cell
Done When: A 9x9 grid of hidden tiles appears in Play mode

Title: Write CameraController.Fit() for portrait screens with space for the top and bottom bars
Done When: The whole board is visible and centred in the Device Simulator on a phone

Title: Write InputHandler with Pointer.current: screen position to grid (x, y), tap detection
Done When: A tap logs the correct cell on the phone and with the mouse in the editor

Title: A tap opens a single cell and redraws it
Done When: The tapped tile shows its number, an empty tile or a red flag

Title: Long press (0.4 s held still) toggles a flag; implement Board.ToggleFlag
Done When: Long press places and removes a flag; a flagged cell can't be opened

Title: Finish TileView.Refresh() for every cell state
Done When: Each state shows the right sprite

Title: Test tap and long press on the phone; tune longPressTime
Done When: Taps always hit the cell under the finger and long press feels natural

Title: Implement flood fill in Board.Reveal() with a Queue (BFS)
Done When: Tapping a 0 opens the empty region and its numbered border

Title: Make Reveal() return the changed cells and add BoardView.RefreshCells()
Done When: Only the changed tiles are redrawn

Title: Place the red flags (mines in code) on the first tap instead of when the board is created
Done When: 20 first taps in a row are all safe and each opens an area

Title: Test flood fill on a 16x30 board on the phone for speed and correctness
Done When: No lag or errors; flagged cells are never opened

Title: Create the GameState enum and the GameManager script (OnTap, OnLongPress); move input handling into it
Done When: GameManager owns the Board and switches Ready to Playing on the first reveal

Title: Handle a loss: show all red flags, highlight the hit one, cross out wrong yellow flags, block input
Done When: Opening a red flag ends the round and the board can't be changed

Title: Handle a win: detect it, cover the remaining red flags with yellow flags, block input
Done When: Opening the last safe cell ends the round as a win

Title: Add NewGame() restart with a temporary on-screen button
Done When: The button gives a fresh board in any state with no leftover tiles and every cell hidden

Title: Add a Canvas with Canvas Scaler (Scale With Screen Size, 1080x1920, Match 0.5), EventSystem and TextMeshPro
Done When: Text appears at the same relative size on different phones in the Device Simulator

Title: Add the SafeArea script on the UI root panel
Done When: UI stays clear of the notch on a notched phone in the Device Simulator

Title: Top bar: red flag counter (red flags - yellow flags) and timer (starts on first reveal, stops at end, caps at 999)
Done When: Both update correctly; the counter can go negative

Title: Face button with normal / pressed / win / lose states that restarts on tap; remove the temporary button
Done When: The face matches the state and tapping it restarts

Title: Bottom bar: flag-mode toggle (pickaxe / yellow flag icon) calling GameManager.ToggleFlagMode()
Done When: In flag mode a tap flags; the button shows the active mode

Title: Win and loss message panel with Play again and Menu buttons; the loss panel shows a random line from Assets/Text/loss_lines.txt (LossLines helper; create the file with a few lines)
Done When: The panel appears at the end of a round; each loss shows a line from the file; a line added to the file appears without code changes

Title: Stop touches on UI from reaching the board; build to the phone; tag v0.1-mvp
Done When: Tapping buttons never opens a tile; a full round works on the phone; the tag is on GitHub

Title: Create the DifficultySettings ScriptableObject and Beginner 9x9/10, Intermediate 16x16/40, Expert 16x30/99 assets
Done When: Three assets exist with the correct sizes and mine counts

Title: Create the static GameSession class and read it in NewGame()
Done When: The game uses GameSession.Selected, or the default if it's empty

Title: Build the MainMenu scene (scene 0, the first screen): title, three large difficulty cards, settings button; no Quit button
Done When: The app opens on this screen; the layout matches the GDD sketch and sits inside the safe area

Title: Scene loading, Menu button, and Android Back (Escape key): game to menu, menu to quit
Done When: Back behaves correctly on the phone; Menu to Game to Menu works repeatedly with no errors

Title: Test all screens in the Device Simulator on a 16:9 phone, a 20:9 notched phone and a 4:3 tablet
Done When: Board and UI fit on all three with nothing hidden or overlapping

Title: Pinch to zoom in CameraController, limited between minimum size and whole board visible
Done When: Pinching zooms smoothly on the phone and never ends in a tap

Title: One-finger drag to pan, clamped to the board; a drag never counts as a tap
Done When: The view follows the finger and can't leave the board

Title: Chording: tapping an opened number calls Board.Chord()
Done When: It opens neighbours only when the flag count equals the number; a wrong flag causes a loss

Title: Save and load the best time per difficulty with PlayerPrefs
Done When: A best time survives closing and reopening the app

Title: Show best times on the menu cards and New record! on the win panel
Done When: Cards show a time or a dash; the message appears only on a record

Title: Pause the timer while the app is in the background (OnApplicationPause)
Done When: Pressing Home for 30 s doesn't add 30 s to the timer

Title: Find sound effects: tap, flag, flood fill, loss (hitting a red flag), win (check the licences)
Done When: 5 clips are in Assets/Audio with licences noted

Title: Write AudioManager and play the sounds on game events
Done When: Each event in the GDD feedback table plays its sound

Title: Settings panel with Sound and Vibration toggles saved in PlayerPrefs
Done When: Both settings stay as chosen after reopening the app

Title: Haptics helper: vibrate on long-press flag and on loss
Done When: The phone buzzes on those events only when Vibration is on

Title: Pressed tile highlight and pressed face while a finger is held on the board
Done When: The tile under the finger darkens and the face changes; both reset on lift or drag

Title: Tile pop animation when opened
Done When: Opened tiles scale up briefly and back

Title: Camera shake on loss
Done When: The camera shakes briefly and returns to its exact position

Title: Unity Test Framework (already installed): create a Core asmdef and an Edit Mode test asmdef
Done When: An empty test runs green in the Test Runner window

Title: Write unit tests for Board (mine count, safe area, numbers, flood fill, flags, win, chord, Expert 16x30) and LossLines (skips empty and # lines, empty list)
Done When: At least 9 tests, all passing

Title: Run through the manual test checklist in the progress tracker on the phone
Done When: Every item is checked; failures are added to the bug list

Title: Fix the bugs found
Done When: No High-severity bugs left open

Title: Player Settings: package name, version, adaptive icon, splash, portrait only, IL2CPP + ARM64, min/target API level
Done When: All settings are filled in and a build succeeds with them

Title: Remove BoardDebug and unneeded Debug.Log calls; set Application.targetFrameRate = 60
Done When: The Console is clean during normal play and the game runs at 60 fps

Title: Create a keystore and make a signed release build (APK; AAB if publishing); back up the keystore outside Git
Done When: A signed APK installs on the phone without Unity; the keystore has a backup

Title: Test the release build on 2+ devices: notch, Back button, phone call / lock screen mid-game, return to app
Done When: Everything behaves as described in the GDD edge-case table

Title: Upload the AAB to Google Play internal testing
Done When: The app installs from the Play internal-testing link

Title: Finish any tasks that slipped from earlier weeks
Done When: No Must tasks left open

Title: Write the repository README.md: description, touch controls, phone screenshots, build steps
Done When: The README is visible on GitHub

Title: Tag v1.0, then fill in the retrospective. Optional: share the APK on itch.io
Done When: The tag is on GitHub and the retrospective is written
